calculation.description: At decision date t, multiply the prior completed session's 20-session price momentum by the log volume shock relative to the median volume through t-2. Positive abnormal volume amplifies continuation; non-shock volume contributes zero. All inputs are lagged to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: 10-session forward cross-sectional Spearman IC passes the benchmark gates. 2022 was negative, while 2026 ICIR was 0.0842; uncertainty is material because the effective cross-section averages 8.92 of 15 instruments. One- and five-session ICIR did not pass.
